conditions: Admin navigates to the back-office product list
items.expected: The product list is visible and each product shows its name and price

conditions: Administrator is signed in and on the admin product list
Search term matches one or more product names (e.g. 'Pliers')
items.expected: Only products whose names contain the search term are shown; non-matching products are absent

conditions: A customer account (non-admin) navigates directly to the admin product list URL
The user is not signed in as an administrator
items.expected: The admin product list is not shown; the customer does not see the list

conditions: Administrator is signed in and on the admin product list
A search term is entered that matches a subset of products
items.expected: Only products matching the search term are shown (bug: the list is NOT narrowed — expected to fail while TOOL-21 is Active)

conditions: Admin product list page is open
axe-core scans the admin product list container with wcag2a and wcag2aa tags
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported (violations array is empty)

excluded.what: bug #TOOL-20 (Billing address step is not filled in from the customer's profile)
excluded.reason: TOOL-20 is about the checkout billing address step (TOOL-16), not about the admin product list. It does not touch any behaviour defined in TOOL-19.

AC-3 (customer cannot see admin list) is the access-control criterion. It is tested as functional (D3): the test observes through the browser that the list is absent. No additional security test beyond this browser-level check is implied by the story or its context.
